text: Dawkins's concept that a parasite's genes can express themselves in the body and behavior of its host, so that the manipulated zombie-ant behavior is really a phenotypic expression of the fungus's genome, is called the ___.
explanation: The answer is the extended phenotype. Dawkins (1982) argued that gene effects can reach beyond the organism's own body; the Ophiocordyceps-directed ant behavior is part of the fungus's extended phenotype, even though the cognitive computation of navigation is still carried out by the ant's own nervous system.
